observations: Three photos show a PlayStation 4 Slim console with a green camouflage skin.
Two DualShock 4 controllers, also with matching camouflage skins, are placed on top of the console.
The console and controllers appear to be in good cosmetic condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the front of the console in photo 1 and photo 2.
No disc drive is visible, consistent with the PS4 Slim model.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
The background shows boxes labeled 'HAVEL' which are unrelated to the console.
No games, game cases, or digital game list are visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: The model is identified as PS4 Slim from the design, but the 1TB storage capacity cannot be confirmed from the photos. No label or screen shows the storage size.
No screen or list of installed games is visible. The games are not shown in any photo, and remote verification is impossible without access to the console.
Two controllers are visible in all photos, matching the description of one extra pad.

risks.risk: Console may not be 1TB model; could be 500GB or 2TB.
risks.proof: Photo of the console's label or system settings screen showing storage capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 500GB model (lowest common capacity), which is cheaper than 1TB.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be corrupted/missing.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the console's game library or a video showing the games loading.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no games included, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Console or controllers may be non-functional or have hidden damage.
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting, and playing a game, and controllers connecting and responding.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number.
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number on the console's bottom or back, and verification via official Sony service (not possible remotely).
risks.if_unproven: Priced with a discount for potential legal risk, as stolen goods are common in second-hand markets.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's label or system settings screen showing storage capacity.
Screenshot or video of the game library showing 15 installed games.
Video of the console powering on and playing a game, and controllers connecting.
Photo of the serial number on the bottom or back of the console.
response.reason: The console model is identifiable, but critical claims about storage size and installed games cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks include non-functionality, incorrect storage, and potential theft. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be evaluated further.
